fields.title: Sen'i Shōnin no Kyoka Fushitsu ni kansuru Gyōsei Hōkoku

report.subject: Watanabe Shizuko no shōgyō kyoka fushitsu ni kansuru fukyū chōsa
report.author: Yamamoto Kenzo

fields.summary: Sen'i shōnin no kyoka torikeshi to kōshō hiyō kōryō ni kansuru gyōsei chōsa hōkoku.
findings: Sen'i shōgyō no kisei wa keizai tōsei rei ni kanzen ni gōchi shite iru.
Shinseisha no kyoka fushitsu seikyū wa, senji tōsei hōsei no kanzen na tekiō de ari kyakka ga tatō.
recommendations: Banding o kyakka shi (reject), gembatsu kitei o izhi suru koto.

claims.fact: Gyōsei hōkoku wa, tōsei rei no tekiō ni yori seikyū o kyakka suru koto o suishō shite iru.
